title: Share a document
goal: Share a document so someone else can open it

steps.say: Open the document you want to share.
Click Share in the toolbar at the top of the window.
steps.find: the Share button in the toolbar

instead.say: If you do not see Share, open the File menu and choose Share.
instead.find: the File menu in the menu bar

steps.say: Choose who can open it: only people you invite, or anyone with the link.
Pick how to send it, for example Mail, Messages or Copy Link.
steps.find: the list of ways to send it

steps.say: Click Share to send the invitation.
steps.find: the Share button at the bottom of the window
